notes.title: Malfunction's 10 Year Anniversary
notes.content:
[h3]On this day, 10 years ago, 11/12/14, Malfunction was born.[/h3]
It's been a great journey thus far and I am proud to announce I have returned from hiatus. Here's a deep-dive on the beginning phases of Malfunction:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40929880/ef1df9cdc8b0236f609b689c37937d830d4b0a25.png[/img]

Malfunction's early stages were quite unknown. I had thrown together a robot character (now known as Dwenguil) who could interchange between several modes which allowed the player to traverse various environments. Below is the first picture featuring said modes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40929880/660b5e8dd96ebff2ac7a8057cf4065d24fe02a94.png[/img]

The game's original codename was "Error" and stuck with that title several weeks prior to the change of "Malfunction". In early production, it's concept was considered to be a sandbox/creative game. However a fully driven story felt more appropriate for the project.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40929880/e9e74609ee6e2b1249e3ffac42dbd98d6e80efda.png[/img]

As soon as a story mode had been decided, it was at this point the levels that are available today were in development. The game had went through several overhauls and re-designs throughout it's years, though the core foundation itself had always been the same.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40929880/0d9b699e0b20c200ce87cf901291fc30ada1483a.png[/img]

This was Malfunction, and it was here to stay. I could go on about it's life throughout development however a majority of it's changes were documented online via IndieDB as well as Steam.

Creating Malfunction was a huge learning experience. It was the first fully fledged game I had ever built. It was the first game I was able to sell and debut onto Steam. It was a huge stepping stone for both Malfunction & Barlock Games. Though it doesn't end there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40929880/c50d7efed9b5b3891b6dd97580f9007d891759d4.jpg[/img]

With the return of my hiatus, I plan to re-visit every game I've released and fix a LOT of crucial issues. Starting with Super Squash. You'll hear more about this very soon.

notes.title: Malfunction II - V-3.0
notes.content:
[h1]Surprise! Malfunction II - V-3.0 IS HERE![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40929880/e289fec89fee9dbe3d4480de51410de1d77c5aec.png[/img]
It's been a long wait yes, but I promise it'll be worth it! Let's discuss some of the biggest additions.

[h1]New Narrative:[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40929880/f0ad74cc1bc6a0ec1a1940106010f5e58a546440.png[/img]
Dwenguil is no longer alone on the Isolate Chasm- Throughout your journey you'll find many friends who all share the same goal; Stop the evergrowing Plague. Did I mention there's actually a villain now too? [b]I suppose it's also worth mentioning this update closes Malfunction II's story.[/b]

[h1]Side Missions:[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40929880/003b093a4c6081dccba8d202355999397cc34f79.png[/img]
Dwenguil has much more exploring to do! Every level now has a side mission alongside them which branches out entirely new environments, unique puzzles and fun combat scenarios. Seriously, check them out. They're a lot of fun!

[h1]New Missions & Regions:[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40929880/5298e2945965ac8d8b04c1975732852faee422ee.png[/img]
That's right! On-top of the side missions you also get your traditional addition of 2 new missions & 2 new regions. If you've been around since 1.0 you might recognize some of the areas; as they were originally cut but have been completely restored and overhauled.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40929880/8adbbd4cda1684258db372881b886e8e95573cc3.png[/img]

[h1]Intel Database:[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40929880/0c95a3ab2426013ee1457d1924a2b41f6fc69bc2.png[/img]
If you were around in the Malfunction I days (I salute you), Malfunction I had a very simplistic Journal Note system which essentially gave brief backstories of certain areas/characters. Malfunction II brings back this system but dives a little bit deeper: Each entry you locate includes 5 pages of lore which expands upon the Isolate Chasm, events after Malfunction I, etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40929880/ba531716e67d4f04385ecb2cc51cf8ad70391ecf.png[/img]
If you ever locate any, give them a read! [i]They can get rather dark at times but that's fun- right?[/i]

[h1]Quality of Life Improvements:[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40929880/d2889e0a01ff404135f334bd12f78f7ecb58472f.png[/img]
Oh boy. There are a LOT of improvements on this update. From re-making models to improving the combat system (LOTS of bug fixes as well); 3.0 introduces not only a lot of additions but fixes as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40929880/ef6f1a7f44f44e4315d0920d53204f2ff63cc340.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40929880/2a3f18de4e08f3809444bb55498b3241275adc55.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40929880/ab206ddadfd8bb19788539720b5da6de9a4a6f96.png[/img]

[h1]Patch Notes:[/h1]

[b]Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added NEW NARRATIVE (While the story is still similar, you can now expect new cutscenes, dialogue & new characters)
[*]Added 2 NEW levels (These were cut levels that have been completely overhauled and reworked)
[*]Added 2 NEW regions (Featuring several new environments, puzzles & combat scenarios)
[*]Added 6 NEW side missions (These missions are found whilst playing the story and consist of new environments, puzzles & combat scenarios)
[*]Added 3 NEW enemies (All of which feature significant & challenging mechanics)
[*]Added NEW skill sets (These skill sets can be unlocked via completing side missions. Skills include: Mortar Scope & Health Extension)
[*]Added NEW double jump mechanic (This will be required for certain areas of the game)
[*]Added NEW combat system (Dwenguil now shoots bullets which will also display an arrow indicating where the player is aiming)
[*]Added NEW Intel Database (Intel will now be scattered throughout the game and consist of lore across Malfunction's universe)
[*]Added 10 NEW Steam Achievements
[*]Added damage & attack animations to enemies
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed the game from staying paused after finishing ending cutscene (LVL2)
[*]Fixed the game from staying paused after finishing mid-cutscene (LVL3)
[*]Fixed several deprecated items still being accessible (LVL3)
[*]Fixed the game from abruptly changing or stopping music (Region 2 & LVL3)
[*]Fixed the performance of Region 2 (further improvements may be added in the future)
[*]Fixed hack screens and terminals from soft-locking the game when pressing ESC
[*]Fixed the loading screen from occurring when destroying a new enemy
[/list]
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed ALL Intro Recap images (overhauled and updated)
[*]Changed ALL Cutscene images (reworked and updated)
[*]Changed Dwenguil's original frame (it has been reworked from the ground up to look more overworn & damaged)
[*]Changed Dwenguil's idle and moving effects (they are now more detailed)
[*]Changed Dwenguil's trail effects (they have been remade from the ground up to look more in-depth)
[*]Changed & overhauled plenty of models throughout the game (boxes, crates, walls, enemies, environmental objects, etc)
[*]Changed Barloc enemy: His attacks are now constant & his animations have been re-worked and improved
[*]Changed Plague Drone enemy: Model has been completely re-made and split into 3 different variations
[*]Changed all Region collectables to be more visible
[*]Changed all interactable objects to more visible
[/list]
[b]Removed:[/b]
[list]
[*]Removed un-used/deprecated assets to save memory & performance (models, sprites, sounds, etc)
[/list]

[b]This also concludes Malfunction II's Early Access state. This does not mean I'm finished with the game. I'm simply done with the story. Expect to hear more on that soon.[/b]

[h3]Until next time![/h3]

notes.title: Malfunction II - 11/22 Blog
notes.content:
[h1]Hello again everyone![/h1]
Instead of leaving you all in the dark I figured I'd throw together a little blog to showcase some things I've been working on in addition to the next Malfunction II update (which will officially be addressed as [b]3.0[/b])

While the update itself was relatively close to launch, I took a step back and asked myself "how can both new and old players enjoy this update?" Here's what I've concluded.


[h2]Side Missions:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40929880/db163c9c995ad3d91051617cb7c2c281757938cb.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40929880/d2889e0a01ff404135f334bd12f78f7ecb58472f.png[/img]
Side missions will be optional objectives found throughout the story which will branch out entirely new environments, puzzles and combat scenarios. Upon completion you will be rewarded with upgrades to your character (more on that later). Each and every story mission will include a side mission.


[h2]Intel Database:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40929880/0c95a3ab2426013ee1457d1924a2b41f6fc69bc2.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40929880/ba531716e67d4f04385ecb2cc51cf8ad70391ecf.png[/img]
The Intel Database will act very similar to the Journal Note system of Malfunction I but will take a rather more in-depth approach to the lore. Each entry you collect will unlock an additional chapter (5 pages) of extra lore for you to dig into. It gets rather dark in some areas but it's totally worth a read!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40929880/302add4ba0a37d95650c000a9a4b010b30b69035.png[/img]
You can expect to find one Intel Entry per-level in sometimes somewhat hidden areas (as shown above).


[h2]Quality of Life Improvements:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40929880/d7253bb2b7de5e048e0ecc406bb315c03c2fbd13.png[/img]
While this was addressed in the last blog, I want to reiterate here that ALL areas of the game have been revisited- Whether that may be performance fixes, gameplay improvements, model replacements or downright overhauls- Malfunction II 3.0 will tackle a lot of areas most wouldn't notice (ALL of which will be noted in the update log once it's launched)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40929880/2a3f18de4e08f3809444bb55498b3241275adc55.png[/img]
For example here's a Turret model I've overhauled to look more appropriate to the game's design.


[h1]Closing Thoughts:[/h1]
While I realize the last update (2.0) was launched almost...8 months ago...Malfunction II 3.0 still unfortunately does not have an ETA but progress is looking as good as ever! Fortunately you can expect to see future monthly blogs similar to this one! Until next time, have yourselves a good one!

notes.title: Malfunction II - September QOL
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]
[b]I know there's been a long gap of silence in regards to Malfunction II's status and what's planned for the future. However I'd like to assure everyone right now that the game is still very much in development and things have been shaping up into something special.

Let's discuss some of what you can expect.[/b]


[h2]New Levels & Regions:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40929880/34d249eea8dda29db4e5b64d6717c6ff612a4902.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40929880/04cc802a116285262c3e7b8b5e24bd89c44de236.png[/img]
[b]As you can see, I have been hard at work on renovating and overhauling levels that were originally cut from the game. They are COMPLETELY different from their original counterparts.[/b]


[h2]New & Improved models throughout the game:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40929880/ab206ddadfd8bb19788539720b5da6de9a4a6f96.png[/img]
[b]While there would be too many models to list here, one I'd like to share with you all is Dwenguil's original frame! I have completely remade his model from the ground up just to emphasize on how much damage his frame has sustained throughout his past.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40929880/46f7087cd84c4e413749d72e1c331af630053d19.png[/img]
[b]Dwenguil's effects and animations have also been completely re-worked as well.[/b]


[h2]Other additions and Quality of Life improvements:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40929880/9e05a3db4c3168e46b41dd9290a89f7c24c60c21.png[/img]
[b]One of the most notable additions coming to Malfunction II are Journal Notes! Yes, they are finally coming back and will dive DEEP into the lore of Malfunction I's aftermath. You can also expect to find journal notes regarding other aspects of the universe as well. Other additions include: New enemies, new combat system, overhauled & improved mechanics for existing enemies, and of course new puzzles![/b]


[h3]While there is definitely MUCH MORE on the pipeline, I hope you enjoyed this short little glimpse at to what's to come.[/h3]

[b]While I don't have an ETA, you can expect to at least hear more very soon.[/b]

Have a good one everyone!

notes.title: Malfunction II - V-2.0 Available NOW
notes.content:
[h1]Malfunction II - V-2.0 NOW Available![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40929880/1886143d824263f1494b46506032972f81336c3c.png[/img]
[h2]That's right! Let's list off some of the biggest features.[/h2]


[h1]Overhauled narrative & story:[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40929880/a4c0a41fb2195ecd8f890ac2a9505ac6e8fa65fa.jpg[/img]
[b]Malfunction II's entire narrative has been changed. Dwenguil has awoken on the Isolate Chasm; a planet that is surrounded by a inescapable barrier built of an unknown origin. The only thing that remains on the Isolate Chasm is Dwenguil and the fierce threat known as the Plague. However...the Plague aren't quite the same as they once were. With the amount of time they've been capsuled, the Plague has evolved into something much more intelligent and if nothing is done they will successfully pass through the barrier; potentially putting an end to the entire universe. Dwenguil must plan accordingly and use his surroundings to construct a weapon that'll end the Plague- once and for all.[/b]

[h1]Overhauled & NEW levels:[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40929880/803f2fe5a8255939153e9d8fead92c9bbb834d8e.png[/img]
[b]While V-2.0 does introduce new levels, the existing ones have been COMPLETELY reworked.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40929880/a4cc5a00d9c743db4980d137cde7b94fa7113592.png[/img]
[b]As you can see, each area has it's own distinct style. Malfunction II's goal from the very start is to introduce the most immersive and detailed environment ever created in Barlock Games' history.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40929880/ea80fe278594d32df8511180826eb23bc2f7b338.png[/img]
[b]The Plague's presence is also very clearly obvious now![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40929880/5b478df761e99b9519255e3eb482545e5899b087.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40929880/c9a8f540fe57a30bebc2e696b94989ecfd3c2766.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40929880/e58a9d80e3693b35a9d160114b82cc0143eb4ef8.png[/img]

[h1]Regions:[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40929880/6ec169fc2ee9a84b6c4afd7a54690aeae1538ef3.jpg[/img]
[b]Regions will act as an overworld upon completion of each mission. Throughout each Region will lie several objectives- some of which will consists of puzzles or combat scenarios. In order to progress through the story ALL of these objectives must be completed.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40929880/a382a05cdcc64612ab30b5bbbd732fb2694c7f6d.png[/img]
[b]Though do not worry! They all offer fun and unique experiences on-top of the already robust package that is Malfunction II.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40929880/bebfd3bbba7c981e8486325a7f09cac8ca615333.png[/img]


[h1]Various Additions & Improvements:[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40929880/19c2afaf97625f183b55235ff46d14642b199125.png[/img]
[b]While there are WAY too many things to list here, some of the most notable changes would be; NEW Enemies (and existing ones have been reworked), NEW model replacements throughout the game, Gameplay & UI improvements (and several additions including accessible hints, save/load implementation & improved animations)[/b]


[h1]Enjoy Malfunction II - V-2.0![/h1]
[b]Stay tuned for future updates.[/b]

notes.title: Malfunction II - Free to Play
notes.content:
[h1]Malfunction II is going Free-to-Play![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40929880/1886143d824263f1494b46506032972f81336c3c.png[/img]

[h2]What does this mean for paid owners?[/h2]
Don't worry! Existing owners will not be forgotten. I have quite a few things in plan for them that'll show my gratitude.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40929880/50b2c4eeddda728434a716946ecff69c0f487412.png[/img]
That's right! [b]Just make sure you either launch the game or have an existing save BEFORE the update drops (V-2.0)[/b] and you'll have indefinite access to all Frames. You will of course also have my special thanks for helping this game see the light of day.


[h2]Why & when will Malfunction II go Free-to-Play?[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40929880/6ec169fc2ee9a84b6c4afd7a54690aeae1538ef3.jpg[/img]

[b]Why:[/b] Malfunction II is quite simply a game that I want everyone to experience...and at this point it was an obvious but clear decision to drop the price. Don't worry though! [b]This will have ZERO impact on future updates![/b] In fact you should expect more frequent updates.

[b]When:[/b] You can expect the free-to-play transition to happen with Malfunction II's next content update.


[h1]Malfunction II - V-2.0[/h1]
[b]Malfunction II's latest update (V-2.0) will be dropping next week![/b] I'll reveal more details at it's launch but here are some screenshots:
